notes.title: Explanation on the progress of the game
notes.content:
[b] It was originally scheduled to update the second phase of the game's main storyline today, but because my phone was broken, I had to transfer the security token to another phone. After transferring the token, the game version cannot be changed within 72 hours, so the update can only be postponed
Things haven't been going smoothly lately haha

[b] Regarding updates: [/b]
Since the delay in the update cannot be avoided, I have decided to release it together with this update in the next update

[b] Next update: [/b]
1. Including the second stage of the main storyline

The second part of the main storyline.

[b] Explanation of BUG: [/b]
After saving the nightclub, exiting the game and re reading this save will result in a bug where you cannot exit the nightclub.
Reason: Every time the game restarts, the NPC position will be refreshed to the default location.
At present, no effective solution has been found for this bug. Please do not archive it in nightclubs.

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
[b]Update content:[/b]
1. I redrawn all character sketches and added emoticons.
2. You can have basic interaction with NPC now (it's really basic).
3. Added some unimportant NPCs (atmosphere group members, really unimportant).
4. The nightclub has practical functions now (don't get excited).

[b]Regarding bug feedback,provide the following explanation:[/b]
I can see the discussion area of STEAM, but I can't reply. I even used VPN, but it didn't work.
So I will respond uniformly to the questions raised in the discussion area in the announcement.

Reply to the question raised in the discussion area about "toilet peeping may get stuck":
After repeated testing and testing on different computers, I did not find this bug and did not use any additional scripts.
My suggestion for this is to update the game runtime content.
I regret that this issue has not been effectively resolved.

[b]Draw a pie:[/b]
Still like the old three
1. Join multiple languages in the future.
2. Join dynamic CG in the future.
2. Join more characters in the future.

My primary goal is to complete all the main storylines of the game. Translation work will increase work time and prevent me from investing in the production of the game storyline. Therefore, I need to complete the game storyline before conducting translation work in multiple languages.
